tests.reason: No staging target: the change is two Supabase edge functions plus two pure _shared helpers; the community-app bundle is unchanged. Edge functions have no staging twin (one shared Supabase project; staging frontends use production), so STAGING-VERIFY cannot exercise them (VTID-04860 precedent). The suites fail on origin/main and pass on this branch. After the owner-approved manual dispatch of supabase-functions-deploy.yml (callee first, then caller, conditional on the CUTOVER_DONE/DATA_API_URL secret-name precondition) the deploy is verified read-only: list_edge_functions shows new versions with verify_jwt=true, function logs show no 5xx, no DataApiNotConfiguredError and no new 'fetch-user-context failed' warning; no probe is sent to production.
